img.caption: Fig 2: Main results across CLINC150 / MixATIS / MixSNIPS. Left: Macro-F1; right: set-level Jaccard. CICC is a single-label conformal baseline (only CLINC150 evaluated); MULACONF is a powerset multi-label conformal baseline; QP-OneModel is a 10-shot generative baseline. Ours (red) attains the best Macro-F1 on all three benchmarks and competitive set IoU, without task-specific training. Hatched bars denote unevaluated settings.
